# clavis upgrade

<p class="cli-lead">Install the latest Clavis release</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis upgrade [ARCHIVE] [flags]
```

</div>

Install the latest release, the way this copy was installed:

- **Homebrew, Scoop, WinGet, `go install`**: runs the package manager's
  upgrade after you confirm.
- **Install script or downloaded binary**: downloads the release for
  your system, checks it against the release's `checksums.txt` (and its
  cosign signature when `cosign` is installed), and replaces itself.
- **Docker, Helm, .deb, .rpm, .apk, source builds**: prints the command,
  since those are upgraded outside the CLI.

`clavis update` only checks; `clavis upgrade` installs. With `ARCHIVE`,
it verifies a release you downloaded yourself with cosign, and
`--install` puts it in place.

## Examples

```sh
clavis upgrade
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Without the question, for scripts</p>

```sh
clavis upgrade --yes
```

<p class="cli-example-title">A specific version from a mirror</p>

```sh
clavis upgrade --version 0.3.3 --download-base https://mirror.example.com/clavis
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Verify a downloaded archive, then install it</p>

```sh
clavis upgrade clavis_0.3.3_linux_amd64.tar.gz --install
```
